job.content:
Company Overview:
NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

About the role:
NCS Philippines is seeking a talented Software Engineer (.Net) to join our growing technology team in Makati City, Metro Manila. This is a full-time, onsite position offering an exciting opportunity to develop and maintain robust software solutions using .Net technologies. As a Software Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and deploying high-quality applications that drive our business objectives forward. Your contributions will directly impact the delivery of innovative technology solutions to our clients and internal stakeholders.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable .Net applications and services

  • Write clean, well-documented code following established coding standards and best practices

  • Participate in code reviews and collaborate with team members to ensure code quality and consistency

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimise existing applications to improve performance and reliability

  • Develop and execute unit tests and integration tests to ensure software quality

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications

  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis through deployment and maintenance

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends within the .Net ecosystem

  • Support production systems and respond to technical issues as they arise


What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • Proven experience developing applications using .Net Framework and/or .Net Core

  • Strong proficiency in C# programming language

  • Solid understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns

  • Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, including writing optimised queries and designing schemas

  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git)

  • Knowledge of web development frameworks and RESTful API design

  • Understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum)

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

  • Preferred: Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), microservices architecture, or containerisation technologies

  • Preferred: Experience with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

  • Preferred: Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines

description.full: NCS Philippines, part of the NCS Group and in partnership with Globe, is a technology services firm where people drive innovation. Our people work on impactful projects across digital, cloud, data, and cybersecurity; gaining regional exposure, growing their skills, and helping build solutions that make a real difference.

job.content:
🌟 Build Your Future in Tech as an Associate Software Engineer at Accenture—with FREE PRE-EMPLOYMENT TRAINING!

Starting your career? Step into a role where your curiosity, ideas, and growth truly matter. At Accenture, you'll innovate with global teams, learn industry-leading technologies, and create meaningful impact — from day one.

This is your launchpad to a future-ready tech career.

💼 Where You Can Excel

Choose a path that matches your passion:

  • Functional Development
    Enhance business systems, configure solutions, and support digital transformation.

  • Application Development
    Design and build applications that power real-world organizations.

  • Analytics
    Turn data into insights, create dashboards, and help drive smarter decisions.

  • Software Testing
    Ensure quality, spot improvement opportunities, and elevate user experience.

  • IT Operations
    Support infrastructure, Cloud, and network systems that keep businesses running.

🎓 Who We're Looking For

  • Fresh graduates welcome (IT, Engineering, Business, Math & related degrees)

  • Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn

  • Enjoy solving problems and exploring new technology

If you're driven by growth and excited to build a meaningful career in tech — you'll thrive here.

🎁 Benefits You Can Look Forward To

  • HMO on Day 1 (medical, dental, mental wellness)

  • Free medicines*

  • Paid vacation & sick leave

  • Performance incentives & stock purchase plan

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Learning programs & industry certifications

  • Free pre-employment training*

Terms & conditions apply

Start strong in tech—selected candidates will undergo pre‑employment training, with the opportunity to receive a ₱60,000* sign‑on bonus after successful training completion, subject to terms and conditions.

Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com.

Opportunity to Join Our Davao IT Team

Qualifications:

- Requires extensive relevant hands-on work experience of at least 5 years in a related role and industry.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related/similar discipline.
- Practical experience with the following IT programming languages is required: HTML, CSS, jQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap, C#/ASP.NET MVC, and SQL Server/SQL. Additional skills beyond this list are welcome and considered a plus.
- Demonstrates strong skills in debugging and software enhancements.
- Possesses extensive knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
- Exhibits strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English.
- Displays solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, along with a strong capacity to investigate and resolve defects effectively.
- Results-oriented team player who can work with minimal supervision.
- Knowledgeable about and capable of contributing to the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into our existing software solutions.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision while adhering to company protocols, guidelines, and policies, as well as complying with international and foreign laws related to data privacy.
